tasks.label: hybrid-rag: terminal UI
tasks.detail: Module 6. Needs a real console; VS Code's integrated terminal provides one.

tasks.label: hybrid-rag: scaffold new module
tasks.detail: Generates a running project - typed source, passing tests, and the ARCHITECTURE.md that Stage 1 of the Architect-Worker pattern requires - then indexes the contract so local_rag_search can answer about it. Close the TUI first: embedded Qdrant is single-process.

tasks.label: hybrid-rag: MCP server (stdio)
tasks.detail: Level 0 only. None of its three tools can spend cloud tokens.

tasks.label: hybrid-rag: MCP server (HTTP :8765)
tasks.detail: Same tools over streamable HTTP, for clients that cannot spawn stdio.

tasks.label: hybrid-rag: verify MCP tooling
tasks.detail: Real stdio JSON-RPC handshake from a foreign cwd. Validates both editor configs.

tasks.label: hybrid-rag: doctor (VRAM co-residency)
tasks.detail: Resolved models, index size, budget window. Expect keep_alive -1 and 2 workers.

tasks.label: hybrid-rag: ollama ps (expect ~4.1 GB, 100% GPU)
tasks.detail: Three models co-resident. A fourth entry or a CPU split breaks the envelope.

tasks.label: hybrid-rag: eval harness tests (offline)
tasks.detail: No Ollama, no index, no network.

tasks.label: gate: ruff
tasks.command: uv run ruff check src tests scripts

tasks.label: hybrid-rag: full verification gate
tasks.detail: ruff check, then mypy --strict, then pytest - everything docs/VERIFY.md requires. Sequenced as three dependent tasks rather than chained with '&&', which Windows PowerShell 5.1 cannot parse.

tasks.label: hybrid-rag: recalibrate thresholds
tasks.detail: Mandatory after any reranker or embedder change. Needs data/calibration.

tasks.label: hybrid-rag: setup .env
tasks.detail: Creates a gitignored .env from the example. Never overwrites an existing one.
